scope: Direct PostgreSQL foreign-key children of the current first-order subject-linked table set where the child table is not already first-order subject persistence.
scopeLimitations: This registry captures one FK hop beyond the tested first-order subject persistence set; it is not an arbitrary-depth graph closure.
A transitive FK proves technical lineage only and does not establish disclosure, legal basis, retention or erasure policy.
Children already present in the first-order subject set are intentionally not duplicated here.
Object/media storage, providers, caches, analytics, backups and non-FK transitive identifiers remain outside this registry.
